casino.tip.title: Tip
casino.tip.roulette.0: Even-money bets (red/black, odd/even, 1-18/19-36) pay 1 to 1. If 0 comes up, you get half back.
casino.tip.roulette.1: A straight-up bet pays 35 to 1, but it only has a 1 in 37 chance. For the brave!
casino.tip.roulette.2: Click the line between two numbers to bet on a split; between four, a corner.
casino.tip.roulette.3: Right-click a spot to take back one of your chips from it.
casino.tip.roulette.4: Hold Shift to place or remove five chips at once.
casino.tip.roulette.5: Same as last time? Press Rebet (R).
casino.tip.roulette.6: Dozens and columns cover 12 numbers and pay 2 to 1.
casino.tip.roulette.7: Zero is green and most bets lose to it. Zero Game covers it.
casino.tip.roulette.8: Neighbors of Zero spreads your chips over 17 numbers in a row on the wheel, in one click.
casino.tip.roulette.9: Once I say «no more bets» you can't bet any more. Don't leave it for last!
casino.tip.roulette.10: If everyone presses READY!, the ball spins without waiting for the clock.
casino.tip.roulette.11: Spread your chips: lots of small bets make the game last longer.
casino.tip.blackjack.0: If you go over 21, you lose even if the dealer busts too.
casino.tip.blackjack.1: The dealer draws until 17 and stands on every 17.
casino.tip.blackjack.2: A natural blackjack (21 with two cards) pays 3 to 2.
casino.tip.blackjack.3: Double down: one more card and a double bet. Great with 10 or 11.
casino.tip.blackjack.4: With 12 to 16 against a dealer 7 or higher, hitting is the usual move.
casino.tip.blackjack.5: With 17 or more, standing is almost always best.
casino.tip.blackjack.6: An Ace counts 1 or 11, whichever suits you better.
casino.tip.blackjack.7: Face cards (J, Q, K) are worth 10.
casino.tip.blackjack.8: When the dealer shows a 5 or 6, they are more likely to bust.
casino.tip.blackjack.9: Press DEAL when you finish betting: the round starts without waiting.
casino.poker.title: TEXAS HOLD'EM
casino.poker.rules: You and the dealer: 2 cards + 5 shared.
casino.poker.rules2: Call (2x ante) or fold. Dealer needs pair of 4s+.
casino.poker.round_running: A round is running, wait a moment.
casino.tip.poker.0: Every player plays against the dealer, not against each other.
casino.tip.poker.1: If you fold you only lose the ante. Calling costs twice the ante.
casino.tip.poker.2: The dealer needs a pair of 4s or better to qualify. If not, you get paid on the ante.
casino.tip.poker.3: With a pair or better on the flop, calling is almost always right.
casino.tip.poker.4: A straight pays the ante 1 to 1; a flush, 2 to 1; a full house, 3 to 1.
casino.tip.poker.5: Four of a kind pays the ante 10 to 1; straight flush, 20 to 1; royal flush, 100 to 1.
casino.tip.poker.6: A weak hand with an Ace in it is usually worth a call.
casino.tip.poker.7: With four cards of one suit or an open straight, you can take the risk!
casino.tip.poker.8: The board is shared: your hand is the best 5 cards out of 7.
casino.tip.poker.9: Press ANTE UP, then DEAL NOW if everybody has bet.

casino.guide.p0.title: Casino Guide
casino.guide.p0.body:
Everything you need to play, win (or lose in style) and decorate your own casino.
Turn pages with the arrows or the ← and → keys. Page 2 has the contents: click a topic to jump there.
casino.guide.p1.title: Contents
casino.guide.p2.title: Chips and Cashier
casino.guide.p2.body:
Casino games use chips worth 1, 5, 25, 100 and 500.
Buy chips at the CASHIER: 1 emerald = 10 chips, 1 diamond = 80 chips. You can also cash your chips back into emeralds or diamonds.
Chips make change by themselves: bet 30 with a single 100 chip and the game gives you the change.
casino.guide.p3.title: Lucky Wheel
casino.guide.p3.body:
One FREE spin every day (resets at midnight, server time).
Click the wheel: you can win chips, items, experience, a mystery prize or the JACKPOT shown on the podium.
Operators change the jackpot by sneaking with the item in hand.
casino.guide.p4.title: Slot Machine
casino.guide.p4.body:
Pick your bet and pull the lever. There are 5 lines: three rows and two diagonals.
Three of a kind pays: cherry x6, lemon x12, bell x32, gem x80, star x200, seven x800. Two cherries from the left pay x2.
Three CROWNS pay x120 plus the progressive JACKPOT, which grows with every spin.
casino.guide.p5.title: Plinko
casino.guide.p5.body:
Pick a bet and a risk level, then drop the ball. It bounces through 10 rows of pegs into a slot.
Low risk: even payouts (up to x8). Medium risk: up to x22. High risk: most slots pay little, but the edges pay x55.
On average Plinko returns 95% to 97% of what you bet.
casino.guide.p6.title: Blackjack
casino.guide.p6.body:
Up to 5 players against the dealer. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
Face cards are worth 10 and aces 1 or 11. HIT, STAND, DOUBLE (one more card, double bet) or SPLIT a pair into two hands.
Blackjack (ace + 10 on the first two cards) pays 3 to 2. If the dealer shows an ace you can take INSURANCE. The dealer draws to 17.
casino.guide.p7.title: European Roulette
casino.guide.p7.body:
37 numbers (0 to 36). Place chips on the felt and wait for the ball.
Payouts: straight 35:1, split 17:1, street 11:1, corner 8:1, six line 5:1, dozen or column 2:1, red/black, even/odd or 1-18/19-36 1:1.
There are also racetrack bets: neighbours of zero, tier and orphans. Shift + click places 5 chips at once.
casino.guide.p8.title: Casino Hold'em
casino.guide.p8.body:
Poker against the dealer. Place your ANTE: you get 2 cards and 3 community cards are dealt.
Choose: FOLD (lose the ante) or CALL by paying twice the ante. Two more cards come and the best 5-card hands are compared.
The dealer qualifies with a pair of 4s or better. If not, the ante pays 1:1. If you win, the call pays 1:1 and the ante pays by your hand: straight 1:1, flush 2:1, full house 3:1, four of a kind 10:1, straight flush 20:1, royal flush 100:1.
casino.guide.p9.title: Scratch Cards
casino.guide.p9.body:
Buy tickets at the machine (10 chips each, 1, 5 or 10 at a time).
Scratch the 6 circles with your mouse. Three matching symbols win their prize: from 10 up to 5000 chips.
No need to scratch everything: the ticket knows if you won from the moment you buy it.
casino.guide.p10.title: The Casino Building
casino.guide.p10.body:
In plains, forests, deserts, savannas, taigas and snowy plains a full casino can appear, with every game and its dealers.
Operators can build one with /casino build <x y z> [rotation], give chips with /casino chips <players> <amount> and reset the daily wheel with /casino resetwheel.
casino.guide.p11.title: Furniture
casino.guide.p11.body:
Casino chairs, bar stools and sofas in 4 colors: right-click to SIT (sneak to place blocks on them).
Sofas join with the ones next to them. The bar counter makes inner and outer corners just like stairs.
Put DRINKS on tables and counters: use more on them to add up to 4 glasses.
casino.guide.p12.title: Lights and Signs
casino.guide.p12.body:
NEON LETTERS: place several in a row and right-click to type with your keyboard (it jumps to the next letter by itself). Pick from 6 colors; the color applies to the whole sign.
SIGNS and SCREENS: right-click changes the design (sneak to go back).
ROPE POSTS: the velvet rope stretches between neighbouring posts by itself and nobody can cross it.
casino.guide.p13.title: Atmosphere
casino.guide.p13.body:
The JAZZ SPEAKER plays casino music; right-click turns it on or off. Even with several speakers you hear a single track, louder when you are close.
The crystal CHANDELIER lights up like a glowstone lamp.
Carpet floors in 4 designs, white and black marble (block, stairs and slabs), mahogany panel, gold trim and velvet walls.
casino.guide.p14.title: Play Smart
casino.guide.p14.body:
Chips are pretend money, but emeralds and diamonds are not.
In every game the house wins a little in the long run: if you are losing, get up and go sit at the bar.
Good luck!
